profile.headline: CS @ Umich | SWE Intern @ IBM
profile.summary: Computer Science student at the University of Michigan with an interest in software systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Ceph Storage 🦑 - Optimized dynamic data sharding (pg autoscaler) for automatic balancing of cluster capacity. Reduced inter-zone network traffic through topology aware data replication.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Mobile Apps - Created GEICO App iOS feedback page for internal testers and automated Jira ticket creation for test pipeline failure.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: OPAL HDx Mapping System - Automated UI testing using YOLOv10 deep learning models

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Developed a privileged logistic regression pipeline for detecting Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome in chest x-ray embeddings, achieving an AUC over 84 percent
-Produced a localization map highlighting important regions in chest x-rays for detecting Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome using Convolutional Neural Nets
-Utilized 15 minute intervals of Apple Watch heart rate data to predict Atrial Fibrillation events 5 minutes into the future, achieving an accuracy over 66 precent
-Utilized Pandas and Excel to handle large amounts of user data

projects.title: Firmware Fuzzer
projects.description:
Implemented a Rust-based fuzz testing framework for microcontroller firmware, extending interrupt
request (IRQ) and direct memory access (DMA) coverage to uncover memory safety and reliability issues

projects.title: Multi-threaded File Server
projects.description:
Implemented a concurrent, crash-consistent file server in C++ using upgradable reader-writer locks,
Boost threads, and TCP sockets, enabling file and directory management via network messages
